description: A Laravel app with Pint and Larastan in require-dev. The tests add the PHP stubs to vendor/bin.

files.phpstan.neon:
includes:
    - vendor/larastan/larastan/extension.neon

parameters:
    level: 8
    paths:
        - app
files.app/Models/Invoice.php:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

final class Invoice
{
    /** @var list<string> */
    public array $lines = array();   
}
files.app/Models/Broken.php:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

final class Broken
{
    // phpstan-error method.notFound Call to an undefined method App\Models\Broken::missing().
    // phpstan-error return.type Method App\Models\Broken::total() should return int but returns string.
}
